7.0.0.en:
The admin tab was rewritten in React (`src-tab/`), replacing the materialize page - doorbell cameras are listed now, they were silently skipped before
The tab no longer assumes the web adapter runs on port 8082; it derives host, port and protocol from the URL states
The adapter was refactored: TypeScript 6, @iobroker/eslint-config, gulp removed
**BREAKING:** `build/` is no longer committed and `common.nogit` is set - the adapter can only be installed from npm, no longer directly from GitHub
`ring-client-api` is ESM only and is loaded dynamically now, which fixes `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` on Node.js 22.0 - 22.11
All backend timers are managed by js-controller now and are stopped when the instance unloads
Scheduled jobs (daily sun calculation, auto save) are cancelled on unload and no longer collide between instances
Fixed: the health state was never refreshed after switching a camera light
Fixed: a failing livestream target preparation still deleted the target file and never reported the error to the caller
Fixed: several `async` methods returned before the work they started was finished
Removed the unused config values `email`, `password`, `pollsec`, `sentry_enable`, `timeout` and `twofaceauth`; `renew_registration` has a default now
Removed the leftover `admin/index_m.html` - the configuration dialog has been JsonConfig for a while
#993 Add doorbell_sunray (Battery Video Doorbell 2K) as doorbell
#993 #854 Add stickup_cam_mini_ptz_v1 (Pan-Tilt Indoor Cam) as stickup cam
#993 Unsupported device logging no longer dumps the whole device object (could expose the Ring refresh token in the log)
Devices previously created below `unknown_<id>` are recreated below `doorbell_<id>` / `stickup_<id>`; the old objects stay behind and have to be deleted manually
Adapter requires node.js >= 22 now
Adapter requires admin >= 7.7.22 now
Adapter requires js-controller >= 6.0.11 now
Adapter requires admin >= 7.6.17 now

7.0.0.zh-cn:
在 React（`src-tab/`）中重写了管理选项卡，取代了物化页面——现在列出了门铃摄像头，之前它们被默默地跳过了
该选项卡不再假定 Web 适配器在端口 8082 上运行；它从 URL 状态派生主机、端口和协议
适配器已重构：TypeScript 6、@iobroker /eslint-config、gulp 已删除
**BREAKING：** 不再提交 `build/` 并设置了 `common.nogit`-适配器只能从 npm 安装，不能再直接从 GitHub 安装
`ring-client-api` 仅是 ESM，现在是动态加载的，这修复了 Node.js 22.0-22.11 上的 `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`
所有后端计时器现在都由 js-controller 管理，并在实例卸载时停止
计划任务（每日太阳计算、自动保存）在卸载时取消，实例之间不再发生碰撞
修复：切换摄像机灯光后生命值状态从未刷新
修复：直播目标准备失败仍然删除了目标文件，并且从未向呼叫者报告错误
修复：几个 `async`方法在开始的工作完成之前返回
移除了未使用的配置值 “email”、“password”、“pollsec”、“sentry_enable”、“timeout” 和 “twofaceauth”；“renew_registration” 现在有默认值
删除了剩余的 `admin/index_m.html`-配置对话框已经使用 JsonConfig 一段时间了
#993 添加 doorbell_sunray（电池视频门铃 2K）作为门铃
#993 #854 将 stickup_cam_mini_ptz_v1（Pan-Tilt 室内摄像头）添加为粘贴摄像头
#993 不支持的设备日志记录不会再转储整个设备对象（可能会在日志中暴露Ring刷新令牌）
以前在 `unknown_ `下创建的设备在 `<id>doorbell_`<id>/`stickup_ ``下方重新创建<id>；旧对象留在后面，必须手动删除
适配器现在需要 node.js >= 22
适配器现在需要管理员 >= 7.7.22
适配器现在需要 js-controller >= 6.0.11
适配器现在需要管理员 >= 7.6.17

**CI/CD**：将 ioBroker Copilot 指令模板从 v0.4.0 更新到 v0.4.2
